steps.action_input:
{"code": "def solve():
    examples = [
        ([43, 1, 62, 76, 71], [1]),
        ([89, 27, 12, 22, 54, 61, 14, 76], [75]),
        ([100, 9, 70, 51, 57, 36, 7, 37, 34], [16]),
        ([83, 84, 50], [0])
    ]
    
    for inp, out in examples:
        s = sum(inp)
        mx = max(inp)
        mn = min(inp)
        avg = s / len(inp)
        # Calculate variance-like property: sum((x - avg)**2)
        var_sum = sum((x - avg)**2 for x in inp)
        # Check parity counts
        odds = [x for x in inp if x % 2 != 0]
        evens = [x for x in inp if x % 2 == 0]
        
        print(f"In: {inp}, Out: {out}")
        print(f"  Sum: {s}, Max: {mx}, Min: {mn}, Max-Min: {mx-mn}, Len: {len(inp)}")
        print(f"  Odds: {len(odds)}, Evens: {len(evens)}, SumOdds: {sum(odds)}, SumEvens: {sum(evens)}")
        print(f"  VarSum: {var_sum:.2f}")

solve()"}

    for inp, out in examples:

        odds = sorted([x for x in inp if x % 2 != 0])

        print(f"  SortedOdds: {odds}, Diffs: {odd_diffs}, SumDiffs: {sum(odd_diffs)}")
        if even_diffs and odd_diffs:
            print(f"  abs(SumEvenDiffs - SumOddDiffs): {abs(sum(even_diffs) - sum(odd_diffs))}")

solve()"}
